name: student-campus-portal-public
description: Institution-neutral full-stack campus portal reference implementation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run build -w @portal/api && npm run build -w @portal/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run build:pages -w @portal/web && node scripts/check-pages-output.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @portal/api" "npm run dev -w @portal/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portal/contracts && npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @portal/api && npm run typecheck -w @portal/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @portal/contracts && npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run test -w @portal/api && npm run test -w @portal/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run db:migrate -w @portal/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run db:seed -w @portal/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run db:reset -w @portal/api --
scripts.demo:user: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run demo:user -w @portal/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:public && npm run check:metadata
